words.note: 表示某種價值、影響、魅力或關係能長久維持。
words.example: The novel has an enduring appeal across generations.
words.exampleZh: 這部小說跨越世代仍然具有持久魅力。

exercises.original: The book's timeless appeal has kept it popular for more than a century.
exercises.zh: 這本書歷久不衰的魅力令它一百多年來仍然受歡迎。
exercises.upgrade: The book's enduring appeal has kept it popular for more than a century.

options.explanation: 表示短暫，和一百多年相反。
popular for more than a century 是持久魅力的直接線索。
fashionable 只表示某一時期流行，未必長久。
現代感不等於歷久不衰。

exercises.original: The artist's timeless influence can still be seen in modern design.
exercises.upgrade: The artist's enduring influence can still be seen in modern design.

options.explanation: can still be seen 表示影響長期持續。
只表示潮流性，不等於長期影響。
藝術家的影響不一定是最近才出現。
與 still be seen 相反。

exercises.original: The film's timeless popularity has survived several changes in audience taste.
exercises.upgrade: The film's enduring popularity has survived several changes in audience taste.

options.explanation: 和多次 taste changes 相反。
popular despite changing tastes 是典型 enduring popularity。
只表示現在流行，不說長期。

words.note: 表示某樣作品、設計或風格因高品質、代表性或長期受喜愛而成為經典。
words.example: The little black dress is a classic fashion choice.
words.exampleZh: 小黑裙是一個經典的時尚選擇。

exercises.original: The chair has a timeless design that has been admired for decades.
exercises.zh: 這張椅子的設計歷經數十年仍然受欣賞，是經典設計。
exercises.upgrade: The chair has a classic design that has been admired for decades.

options.explanation: admired for decades + design 是 classic 的典型語境。
可以很創新，但不表示經典。

exercises.original: The novel is timeless and continues to be taught in schools around the world.
exercises.upgrade: The novel is a classic and continues to be taught in schools around the world.

options.explanation: 長期被教授、跨地區認可，符合 classic status。

exercises.original: A navy blazer is a timeless piece that works in many settings.
exercises.upgrade: A navy blazer is a classic piece that works in many settings.

options.explanation: navy blazer + works in many settings 是典型 classic wardrobe item。
不是自然固定表達，而且改變語義。
只表示目前流行，和 timeless 相反。

words.note: 表示某樣東西持續極久，甚至彷彿永遠不會結束。
words.example: The monument was built as a symbol of everlasting peace.
words.exampleZh: 這座紀念碑被建造成永恆和平的象徵。

exercises.original: The poem speaks of timeless love that survives every hardship.
exercises.zh: 這首詩描寫一種經歷任何困難仍不消失的永恆愛情。
exercises.upgrade: The poem speaks of everlasting love that survives every hardship.

options.explanation: survives every hardship + love 是典型 everlasting love。
可形容 love story，但不自然直接表達「永遠持續的愛」。

exercises.original: The memorial was created as a timeless symbol of peace.
exercises.upgrade: The memorial was created as a symbol of everlasting peace.

options.explanation: 也可說 enduring peace，但 everlasting 更強、更象徵性。
memorial + symbolic peace 語境很自然。

exercises.original: The story promises a timeless bond between the two characters.
exercises.upgrade: The story promises an everlasting bond between the two characters.

options.explanation: bond + promises long permanence 是典型搭配。

words.meaning: 不受時代限制的；永不顯老的
words.note: 表示某種美感、魅力、設計或人物形象不受年齡／時代影響。
words.example: The building has an ageless elegance.
words.exampleZh: 這座建築具有不受時代影響的優雅。

exercises.original: The actress is admired for her timeless beauty.
exercises.zh: 這位女演員因她不受年齡影響的美而備受欣賞。
exercises.upgrade: The actress is admired for her ageless beauty.

options.explanation: 可以形容 style，但 classic beauty 更像傳統審美類型；此句重不顯老／跨年齡。
beauty 是 ageless 的標誌性搭配。
現代感不等於不受年齡影響。

exercises.original: The building has a timeless elegance that still feels fresh today.
exercises.upgrade: The building has an ageless elegance that still feels fresh today.

options.explanation: 也很自然，但 still feels fresh today 更強調不受年代影響。
elegance + unaffected by era 是典型用法。

exercises.original: The logo's timeless simplicity helps it work across different generations.
exercises.upgrade: The logo's ageless simplicity helps it work across different generations.

options.explanation: 可能某一時期流行，但跨世代未必。
也很合理，但 across different generations 更直接支持 ageless。
跨世代仍有效，是 ageless 的核心。

words.note: 表示某種影響、效果、印象或關係持續很久。
words.example: The speech made a lasting impression on the audience.
words.exampleZh: 這場演講給觀眾留下了持久印象。

exercises.original: The teacher's timeless influence continued long after the students had graduated.
exercises.zh: 學生畢業很久之後，老師的影響仍持續存在。
exercises.upgrade: The teacher's lasting influence continued long after the students had graduated.

options.explanation: continued long after 是 lasting influence 的直接線索。

exercises.original: The trip left a timeless impression on everyone who took part.
exercises.upgrade: The trip left a lasting impression on everyone who took part.

options.explanation: classic impression 不是自然搭配。
lasting impression 是固定常見搭配。

exercises.original: The policy had a timeless effect on the structure of the industry.
exercises.upgrade: The policy had a lasting effect on the structure of the industry.

options.explanation: effect on the structure 表示長期影響，lasting 最自然。

words.note: 最直接地表示某種服裝、設計或風格不會因潮流變化而失去吸引力。
words.example: A simple white shirt is never out of style.
words.exampleZh: 簡單的白襯衫永不過時。

exercises.original: A well-cut black suit is timeless.
exercises.zh: 剪裁得宜的黑色西裝永不過時。
exercises.upgrade: A well-cut black suit is never out of style.

options.explanation: 價格和風格持久性無關。
這是 fashion sense 下最直接的日常改寫。
formal 和 timeless 是不同概念。
只表示現在流行，不保證長久。
製作方法傳統不等於不過時。
意思相近但不自然，也不是固定表達。

exercises.original: Simple wooden furniture can look timeless in almost any home.
exercises.upgrade: Simple wooden furniture can be never out of style in almost any home.

options.explanation: interior design + works across homes and trends 是最直接意思。
不自然，而且「傳統」不等於 timeless。

exercises.original: The designer wanted a timeless look rather than something that would feel dated in a few years.
exercises.upgrade: The designer wanted a look that would never go out of style rather than something that would feel dated in a few years.

options.explanation: rather than ... feel dated 幾乎直接定義這個片語。
現在流行的東西幾年後可能正好過時。
製作方式不等於視覺風格耐久。

falseSynonyms.zh: 老派的 ≠ 永恆經典 old-fashioned 通常表示過時或不符合現代潮流，和 timeless 幾乎相反。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A timeless design still looks good today. An old-fashioned design may look outdated.

falseSynonyms.zh: 傳統的 ≠ 永不過時 traditional 只表示符合傳統做法／樣式，不保證長期仍有吸引力。
永久存在 ≠ 永恆魅力 permanent 表示不暫時、不會被移除；timeless 強調不受時代影響。
很接近，但重持續 enduring 不一定涉及 style 或 cultural relevance。
很接近，但常表示已被公認為經典 不是所有 timeless 的東西都已經有 classic status。
更強、更絕對 everlasting 常帶幾乎「永遠」的意味，比 timeless 更誇張。
- time = 時間 - timeless = 不受時間影響的；永恆的
- last = 持續（動詞） - lasting = 持久的（形容詞）
falseSynonyms.point: The effect lasted for years. It had a lasting effect.
